climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: One of Hungary's seven larger wine regions, spread around Lake Balaton and made up of six regions: Badacsony, Balatonboglár, Balaton-felvidék, Balatonfüred-Csopak, Nagy-Somló and Zala.
